The '''Talon Interceptor''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]<ref name="TOR:TI" /> produced by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] around the time of the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]]. Talon Interceptors were assembled by the [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] in its [[Inrokini Stronghold|shipyard]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]].<ref name="TOR:ATAtC" />
